name: Scroll Highlight Reader
description: Long-form article layout where key phrases get highlighted as they scroll into view, with three highlight styles: full background, marker pen and minimal underline.
contents: List of paragraphs with highlighted phrases
behavior: Highlighted phrases activate once when they scroll into the viewport and stay active
Marker pen variant grows a colored bar behind the phrase
Text color and highlight transitions animate over 500ms

props.name: articleTitle
props.default: The Carbon in Our Apple Pies

editableByProps: Title, paragraphs and which phrases are highlighted
Highlight style, highlight color, and all text and background colors

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the trigger point or sensitivity of the highlight
needsCodeEdit.where: rootMargin and threshold in the IntersectionObserver options
font-serif and max-w-2xl classes on the root and main elements

fixed: Renders nothing until mounted on the client
Highlights stay active once triggered and do not reset when scrolling back up

options.look: Phrase gets a filled highlight background with padding and rounded corners
options.useWhen: Article pages where key quotes must stand out strongly

options.look: Marker pen bar sweeps under the lower half of the phrase
options.useWhen: Playful blog posts or case studies with a handwritten feel

options.look: Thin solid underline appears under the phrase
